summary: Add pre-activation Rust sidebar scale and opt-in latency gates

compatibility.detail: Unwired harnesses exercise 1001 agents, 4096 memberships, the admitted folder depth, tied keys, next-frame overlays, oversized atomic rekeys and the real server live-member limit. Run cargo test -p fractal-sidebar --release --test scale -- --ignored --nocapture for p95 projection/planning and TestBackend render gates against an in-run same-data v1 baseline. The TUI sidebar_scale socket initial-load and sustained unrelated-write tests are explicitly ignored pending D #4739; run them in release mode with --ignored after collection-v1 paging lands. These tests must pass before activation.

manual.detail: No operator steps or configuration changes; latency measurements are explicit test runs.

recovery.detail: Unwired test harnesses introduce no persisted state or runtime recovery changes.
